Sarah —

Thanks for the context and for including the timeline. We can support supplemental capacity for RFP bakeoffs, but I need to confirm internal approvals for an exception to the standard trial policy. Two quick asks from our side: 1) can you share the exact test harness (scripts or S3/Drive link) and 2) confirm whether the runs will include any PII or PHI.

If it's purely synthetic/test data we typically approve a time-limited top-up; if there is customer data we need to route it through Security. I can escalate today and get back within 24 hours.

Also, preliminarily: would a 30-day 600k-token top-up cover your runs? If you need higher capacity please quantify and include the procurement contact for the PO.

I'll loop in my manager for approval once you confirm.

Thanks for flagging. I'm okay approving a targeted supplement with the following conditions:

- Approve a one-time 600,000 token credit allocation, valid for 30 days from issuance.
- Customer must confirm: (a) test harness contains NO PHI/PII and (b) only synthetic or anonymized inputs will be used in the evaluation. If PHI/PII is present, route to Security & Private offering.

Sarah —

Good news: we've approved a one-time 600,000 token benchmarking top-up, valid for 30 days from the date it's issued. Please see the terms below (per Sales Ops):

- Allocation: 600,000 tokens, single use window (30 days)
- Allowed usage: benchmarking/eval only — NO production traffic.
- Data: must be synthetic or anonymized; no PHI/PII. Please confirm in writing.
- Procurement: we require a short PO or confirmation email for our records before we provision.
- Audit: we will provide usage logs on request; Redwood reserves the right to revoke credits if terms are violated.

Next steps for you: please reply to this thread with (1) confirmation that test harness is synthetic/anonymized, (2) procurement PO or approval email, and (3) preferred delivery date for the credit (we can provision as soon as we receive PO).

I've attached a simple terms summary and our suggested benchmark plan (benchmark-plan.csv). Also linking a quick DocuSign acknowledgement if you want a signed promo addendum: https://www.docusign.com/quick-sign/abc123

If Nimbus needs more than 600k or wants a longer evaluation window, we'll escalate to Aditya for a commercial exception. Otherwise, once we get the PO we'll provision and I will follow up with runbook instructions.

Thanks — looking forward to their results.
